features.eyebrow: THE BIG PICTURE. THE RIGHT DETAILS.
features.title:
Connected intelligence.
Built around your business.
features.description: Move from disconnected reports to a clearer understanding of what is happening—and what to do next.
features.marketTitle: Know your market, down to the product.
features.marketText: Compare competitors, mapped products, prices, availability, and customer sentiment in context.
features.demandText: Put demand forecasts, uncertainty ranges, and inventory recommendations to work.
features.pricingText: Understand how your prices compare before you make a move.
features.sentimentTitle: Hear the story behind the reviews.
features.sentimentText: See sentiment across your products, competitors, and business.
features.ragTitle: Ask your data. Get grounded answers.

market.title:
A wider view of your market.
A closer look at every product.
market.description: Track the businesses you compete with and the specific products that compete with yours. Bring listings, observed prices, availability, and sentiment into the same conversation.
market.point2: Mapped products and observed market signals
market.point3: Comparable scores with context, not guesswork

demand.title:
Look ahead.
Stock with more confidence.
demand.description: Turn demand signals into a practical inventory conversation. See expected demand alongside its uncertainty range, stock levels, and reorder guidance.
demand.note: Forecasts are estimates, not guarantees. Review the range and your business context before acting.

pricingIntel.title:
Price with perspective.
Not just instinct.
pricingIntel.description: Compare your current price with the market and review a suggested direction. Use matched competitors, confidence, and competitiveness to inform your decision.
pricingIntel.note: Recommendations support your judgment. You remain in control of pricing.

sentiment.title: Understand how your market feels.
sentiment.description: Read beyond a star rating. Explore positive, neutral, and negative sentiment at the product, competitor, and business level—with review volume and reliability in view.
sentiment.limitedText: 8 reviews · Interpret this product's signal with caution.

scoring.title: Scores that help you compare—not oversimplify.
scoring.description: Use distinct measures for distinct questions. Understand price position, overall competition, observed activity, and market relevance side by side.

rag.title:
A better answer starts
with your own information.
rag.description: Ask a business question in natural language. The RAG assistant brings relevant information from your documents into the answer, with sources you can review.
rag.point1: Grounded in the business information you provide
rag.point2: Source documents and relevance, alongside the answer
rag.point3: A conversation in English or Arabic
rag.question: Which product has the strongest demand outlook?
rag.answer: The Everyday blend shows the strongest outlook in this example. Its forecast exceeds current inventory, so review stock availability before your next replenishment.
rag.note: Illustrative response and sources. AI answers should be reviewed.

data.title:
Your business doesn't live
in one spreadsheet.
data.description: Bring multiple sources into one connected foundation. Start with the data you have and add more as your business grows.
data.note: Connection options depend on available integrations. POS and ERP setup details will be defined separately.

ingestion.title: Know what made it into the analysis.
ingestion.description: Review extraction status and data quality. Template compliance, processed rows, header coverage, and detected currency make file handling easier to understand.

models.title:
More than a chatbot.
An intelligence toolkit.
models.description: Different business questions need different kinds of analysis. CEOPRO brings specialized capabilities into one connected experience.
models.pricingText: Suggested price, action, confidence, and market position.
models.sentimentText: Positive, neutral, and negative signals from customer feedback.
models.perceptionText: An aggregate view, with review volume and reliability.
models.demandText: Expected demand, uncertainty, and inventory guidance.
models.marketText: Competitiveness, activity, and relevance in context.
models.ragText: Document-grounded answers with relevant source references.
models.extractionText: Structured information and visible processing outcomes.
models.coreText:
Business context in.
Actionable understanding out.

about.title:
Your business on the inside.
Your market on the outside.
Intelligence that connects both.

about.bilingualText: A bilingual experience, including right-to-left layouts.

trust.uncertaintyText: Read confidence, sample reliability, and forecast ranges in context.
